items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: He's out somewhere around where Johnny Sinceri is.

ctx.x: Yes, it sounds dope. David, he was very good at that. I think he's teaching in California now. I don't think he's playing in the band. He's out somewhere around where Johnny Sinceri is.
Yes, that's what I hear. He's out in California now.
